Name: Simply Cleaner Barns
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
REQUIRES:
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content patcher
[*]Yep. That's it.
[/list]

OVERVIEW:
This mod is designed to be short and simple. Remove the excess clutter and scraps, and patch the holes and loose floorboards Robin, for whatever reason, built into the barns.
This allows players more freedom in where they place their machines and decorations.


The Cellar includes added perks and space.
[list]
[*]Removed excess clutter to allow players more freedom of placement.
[*]Cleaned up the creaky floorboards Robin built in.
[*]Patched the holes in walls Robin punched in.
[/list]

SIDE NOTES:
[list]
[*]If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know in the POSTS!
[/list]
INSTALLATION:
Download the file.
Extract the Folder.
Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
Load with SMAPI.
Enjoy.
